frontier.hypothesis: The delay-slot impossibility (H1) can be demonstrated empirically rather than by compiler-source reading, converting the argument into a measurement for the owner's audit trail.
frontier.mechanism: Direct falsification attempt on H1: if any C spelling could get an __asm__ ctc2 into the jr delay slot, a small sweep would find it; reorg.c's dbr pass dump shows the bail-out directly.
frontier.next_probe: Compile a minimal TU containing only this body with cc1 -da and inspect the .dbr (delay-branch-scheduling) dump for fill_simple_delay_slots halting at the asm insn; sweep 3-4 orderings (ctc2 $7 written first / written last / emitted via a trailing return / split into a separate statement) and show the slot stays nop in every form. Cheap, and it either confirms H1 with measurement or overturns it.

frontier.hypothesis: func_80052B00 is the last unauthorized member of an otherwise fully settled cop2-control-loader cluster, which is a clean completeness argument for frontier item 1.
frontier.mechanism: If every other lw/ctc2/jr-only body in the tree is already in inline_asm_canonical.txt, the category is settled and this function is a straggler rather than a novel case.
